verdict.rationale: HumanLayer's marketing says you can run the HumanLayer stack on your own workstation or remote workers. Its docs show remote daemons running on your own cloud VM, workstation, or private-network machine. However, tasks are controlled from the hosted app.humanlayer.com and automation sessions are 'Cloud-visible', so only the execution side is shown as self-hostable, not the core control plane. Missing for 10: documented self-hosting of the control plane/web app, a self-host deployment guide, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Bring your own compute, development environment, and agent harness, or run the HumanLayer stack on your workstation or remote workers.
The host can be a cloud VM, workstation, or private-network machine.
You will control the task from app.humanlayer.com on a machine or phone.
